blurb: Guests pay admission to enter the arcade and purchase tokens to play arcade games. Tokens can be saved for future visits, and tickets won from games do not expire. The VIP Party Room offers a private space with arcade games, seating, a TV, and tokens for the main arcade, suitable for hosting parties.
extraNote: Tokens can be purchased with cash, coins, debit/credit card, or Apple Pay · Tokens and tickets do not expire and can be saved for future visits · Additional guests for VIP parties attend at discounted rate of $0.50 weekdays or $0.75 weekends, covered by host · Outside food is welcome in VIP room; drinks available for purchase
